scope: Goal token and cumulative ACP USD budget admission, per-request reservations, unknown-usage recovery, branch progress, fixed Windows delivery and packaged acceptance

selftest.execution: fixed release/win-unpacked/CodeNode.exe; isolated user data and project; version 0.13.0

budgetSemantics.builtin: Admission snapshots remaining Goal allowance; each HTTP attempt reserves estimated input, caps actual max_tokens to remaining capacity, and records conservative reservations when provider usage is missing.
budgetSemantics.external: ACP v1 usage_update used/size is context-window occupancy, not cumulative token consumption; CodeNode uses explicit total_tokens only for token overrun. Cumulative USD session cost is charged as the same-session delta from the last persisted frame. Missing or non-USD baselines and counter regressions mark cost unknown; capped Goals require source-noted cumulative reconciliation. In-run cancellation depends on timely provider usage reports.

limitations: Built-in input Token reservations use the existing conservative estimator; provider accounting can vary.
External in-run enforcement depends on timely ACP usage reports; standard context occupancy is not a cumulative token counter.
